seo.title: Christmas Markets in Vienna {{year}}: Opening Hours, Dates & Transport
seo.description: All of Vienna's Christmas markets {{year}} with dates, daily opening hours, district and public transport – plus which markets stay open after 24 December.

christmasVienna.headline: Christmas Markets in Vienna {{year}}: all {{count}} markets at a glance
christmasVienna.headline_one: Christmas Markets in Vienna {{year}}: one market at a glance

intro.season: From {{from}} to {{to}}, squares, palace courtyards and parks all over Vienna turn into Christmas markets – with punch, roast chestnuts and handmade crafts.
intro.about: Here you'll find every market with its dates, opening hours and public transport connections, sorted by location and atmosphere. The details come straight from the events on Share Your Party and update continuously.
intro.empty: As soon as the first Christmas markets of the season are listed, you'll find them here with dates, opening hours and public transport connections.

christmasVienna.empty: There are currently no Christmas markets listed in Vienna.

table.heading: All Christmas markets in Vienna at a glance

timeline.heading: When is which market open?
timeline.note: Each bar runs from the first to the last opening day.

innenstadt.title: Inner City: markets in the 1st district
innenstadt.intro: The markets in the centre are close together – ideal for walking from one market to the next.

schloesser.title: Palaces & landmarks
schloesser.intro: Christmas markets against an imperial backdrop and beneath the Giant Ferris Wheel – some stay open past New Year.

kunsthandwerk.title: Art & crafts
kunsthandwerk.intro: For anyone looking for handmade pieces and design rather than mass-produced goods.

abseits.title: Away from the crowds
abseits.intro: Quieter markets in the outer districts – in the park, in a university courtyard or in the greenhouses.

more.title: More Christmas events in Vienna
more.intro: These Christmas events are listed on Share Your Party and have not yet been editorially categorised.

afterChristmas.heading: Which markets are open after 24 December?
afterChristmas.intro: These markets stay open after Christmas Eve:
afterChristmas.item: open until {{date}}, still open on {{count}} days after 24 December
afterChristmas.item_one: open until {{date}}, still open on one day after 24 December
afterChristmas.none: According to the listed dates, all markets close on 24 December at the latest.

items.title: Go on a weekday.
items.text: At weekends and in the evenings, the markets in the city centre get crowded. A weekday afternoon is much quieter.

items.title: Return your mug.
items.text: Punch and mulled wine usually come in a mug with a deposit. Bring it back to get your deposit refunded – or keep it as a souvenir.

items.title: Use public transport.
items.text: Parking around the markets is scarce. The public transport connection for each market is listed in the overview table.

items.title: Check the hours on 24 December.
items.text: Many markets close early on Christmas Eve. The exact times are on each event page.

faq.heading: Frequently asked questions about Vienna's Christmas markets

opening.q: When do the Christmas markets in Vienna open in {{year}}?
opening.a: The season starts on {{date}} with {{names}}. From {{lastOpening}}, all {{count}} markets are open.

closing.q: How long are the Christmas markets in Vienna open?
closing.a: Open the longest: {{names}}, until {{date}}. Most markets close on {{commonEnd}}.

afterChristmas.q: Which Christmas markets are open after 24 December?
afterChristmas.none: According to the listed dates, all markets close on 24 December at the latest.

entry.q: Do you have to pay to enter Vienna's Christmas markets?
entry.all: No. According to the organisers, entry is free at all {{count}} markets – you only pay for what you eat, drink or buy.
entry.all_one: No. According to the organiser, entry is free – you only pay for what you eat, drink or buy.
entry.some: According to the organisers, entry is free at {{free}} of {{count}} markets. For the others, you'll find the price on the event page.
entry.none: The listed markets charge an entry fee. You'll find the price on each event page.

transport.q: What's the best way to get to the Christmas markets?
transport.a: By public transport: most markets are right next to an underground or tram stop. The connection for each market is listed in the overview table.

outro.heading: All Christmas events on Share Your Party
outro.appText: Keep all markets and your favourites with you in the Share Your Party app:
outro.organizerText: Are you organising a Christmas market or Christmas event in Vienna yourself?

6ad4f9444cb38af994bb48e0.text: Vienna's best-known Christmas market sits right in front of the illuminated City Hall, with decorated trees in the Rathauspark.
6ad4f9444cb38af994bb48e0.transit: U2 Rathaus, U3 Volkstheater · Tram D, 1, 71 Rathausplatz/Burgtheater · Tram 2 Parlament

6ad6718e4cb38af994be12f4.text: Right by St. Stephen's Cathedral in the heart of Vienna – if you're Christmas shopping in the city centre, you'll pass by anyway.

6ad66ff34cb38af994bdf267.text: On one of Vienna's oldest squares, known for handicrafts and carefully chosen gift ideas – just a few minutes' walk from the Graben.
6ad66ff34cb38af994bdf267.transit: U3 Herrengasse, U2 Schottentor, U1 Stephansplatz · Bus 2A Herrengasse

6ad66e524cb38af994bdd220.text: The Old Viennese Christmas Market is all about tradition: handicrafts, nativity scenes and tree decorations, away from the big crowds.
6ad66e524cb38af994bdd220.transit: U3 Herrengasse, U2 Schottentor · Tram 1, 2, 71, D Schottentor/Burgtheater · Bus 1A, 2A Freyung

6ad669964cb38af994bd7a8b.text: Between the Museum of Art History and the Natural History Museum – easy to combine a museum visit with punch and a Christmas stroll.
6ad669964cb38af994bd7a8b.transit: U2 Museumsquartier, U3 Volkstheater · Tram 1, 2, 71, D Burgring

6ad679e44cb38af994bea739.text: Right on the Ringstrasse – for a quick punch stop after work or before a concert at the Konzerthaus.
6ad679e44cb38af994bea739.transit: U1, U2, U4 Karlsplatz · Tram 71, D Schwarzenbergplatz · Bus 4A Schwarzenbergplatz

6ad66b7f4cb38af994bda32e.text: The stalls stand in the imperial courtyard in front of the baroque façade of Schönbrunn Palace – worth a trip between the holidays too.
6ad66b7f4cb38af994bda32e.transit: U4 Schönbrunn · Tram 10, 60 Schloss Schönbrunn · Bus 10A Schloss Schönbrunn

6ad66d694cb38af994bdc579.text: In front of the Upper Belvedere right by the palace pond, with an imperial backdrop and views across the gardens.
6ad66d694cb38af994bdc579.transit: Tram D Schloss Belvedere · U1 Hauptbahnhof · Tram 1, 18, 62, O and S-Bahn Quartier Belvedere

6ad67b6a4cb38af994bec77e.text: At the foot of the Giant Ferris Wheel in the Prater – according to the organiser, open until 2 a.m. on New Year's Eve.
6ad67b6a4cb38af994bec77e.transit: U1, U2 Praterstern · Tram O, 5 · Bus 80A · S-Bahn Praterstern

6ad6762c4cb38af994be5bb0.text: The stalls line the narrow Biedermeier lanes of Spittelberg between historic houses – known for handicrafts and design.

raffleTerms.title: Raffle Terms and Conditions
raffleTerms.notFound: This event is not a raffle.

raffleTerms.eligibilityText: Eligible to participate are natural persons aged 18 or over who reside in Austria. Participation requires a free registration on shareyourparty.de as well as the free booking of a ticket for the event “{{eventName}}”. Only one entry per person is permitted. Participation is free of charge — no purchase is necessary.
raffleTerms.periodText: The raffle starts when the event is published on shareyourparty.de and ends with the draw at the event “{{eventName}}” on {{eventDate}}, {{location}}.
raffleTerms.prizeText: The prize is: {{prize}}. The prize is non-transferable and cannot be paid out in cash. An exchange is excluded.
raffleTerms.drawing: Determination and handover of the prize
raffleTerms.drawingText: The winner will be drawn exclusively on site during the Stammersdorfer Weintage on {{drawDate}}. A draw outside the event is excluded; the prize will not be handed over or sent afterwards.
raffleTerms.drawingTextNoDate: The draw takes place exclusively on site as part of the Stammersdorfer Weintage. A draw outside the event is excluded; the prize will not be handed over or sent afterwards.
raffleTerms.drawingPresenceText: The drawn winner must be personally present at the time of the draw and must accept the prize immediately on site. If the drawn winner is not present, the claim to the prize lapses without replacement and a new winner is drawn immediately. This process is repeated until a winner who is present has been determined.
raffleTerms.drawingNoNotificationText: The winner will not be notified by email, telephone or via the app.
raffleTerms.drawingRemoteText: The winner will be drawn after the end of the participation period. Attendance on site is not required.
raffleTerms.drawingRemoteNotificationText: The winner will be notified via the Share Your Party app and by email to the address provided at the time of entry. If the winner does not respond within 14 days of the notification, the claim to the prize lapses without replacement and a new winner is drawn.
raffleTerms.drawingRemoteHandoverText: The handover of the prize will be arranged individually with the winner. Payment in cash or an exchange of the prize is excluded.
raffleTerms.privacyText: Personal data collected during participation (name, email address and answered questions) is processed for the purpose of conducting the raffle and for transfer to {{partner}}. The winner is determined and the prize handed over exclusively on site; the winner is not notified by email.
raffleTerms.privacyTextNoPartner: Personal data collected during participation (name, email address and answered questions) is processed solely for the purpose of conducting the raffle and is not passed on to third parties.
raffleTerms.privacyLink: Privacy policy of Share Your Party
raffleTerms.marketingText: By participating, you consent to {{partner}} using your email address for marketing purposes, in particular to send information about events, offers and news.
raffleTerms.liabilityText: The organizer is not liable for technical faults that impair participation. No liability is assumed for material defects or defects of title of the prize.
raffleTerms.terminationText: The organizer reserves the right to cancel or terminate the raffle at any time for objective reasons (e.g. abuse, technical problems, cancellation of the event).
raffleTerms.legalText: Legal recourse is excluded. Austrian law applies.
raffleTerms.facebookText: This raffle is in no way connected to Facebook/Meta and is not sponsored, endorsed or organized by Facebook/Meta in any way. The sole contact and responsible party is the organizer named above. The data provided by participants is not transmitted to Facebook/Meta.
